nom: SUNDAY RILEY Juno Antioxidant + Superfood Face Oil

avis.texte: I was hoping ro find a cheaper face oil but im sensitive to smells so its going back

I bought this to try when it was half price. I have really enjoyed the effects. My skin glows when I use this oil. It's a little thinker in consistency than the vitamin C oil Sunday Riley offers but it absorbs just as easily. I'm only a few wells into use but I like it so far. If you are sensitive to scents, be aware that this smells of oregano. It doesn't bother me at all and fades quickly.

avis.titre: Has EVERYTHING I was looking for
avis.texte: Since Kiehls daily concentrate oil was discontinued, I've been shopping for a replacement. This has the omega 3/6/9 all there! It applies slick but eventually settles in. Its kept the annual winter dry patches completely off my face. The only thing I don't love personally is the scent. Its more unisex with a woodsy almost oregano scent. I just prefer something more traditionally feminine. But I think the benefits do outweigh that.

My face gets notoriously dry and flaky. I have tried every moisturizer under the sun and even get hydration facials regularly. This oil is thicker, but I use it 2-4x a week, and always after makeup days! I wash my face and then put a hot washcloth over my face after washing to help open my pores. I put a whole dropper of the oil in my palm and rub it around with my finger until it gets warm. I then massage it into my face and neck. After, I get my washcloth very hot again and lay it over my face until it cools. This helps it settle into my skin even more and not just sit on the surface. My facialist has told me that this oil makes a noticeable difference in my skin dryness when I use it consistently. I have always had great luck with all Sunday Riley products but this is one that I have bought over and over again.

My skin is always dry especially in the winter. I use this in the morning and my skin stays moisturized all day. It absorbs well and isn't greasy or oily. I tried the CEO Glow one and it's not quite enough for my skin so I'm switching back to this one!

avis.titre: Smoothed my skin and minimized breakouts
avis.texte: Super gental on teenage skin (14) smell is a bit strange. I got the small bottle as a gift and it worked so well. I've been out for 2 weeks now and my skin is bumby and dry. Will need to order more!

avis.titre: Smoothed my skin and minimized breakouts
avis.texte: Super gental on teenage skin (14) smell is a bit strange. I got the small bottle as a gift and it worked so well. I've been out for 2 weeks now and my skin is bumby and dry. Will need to order more!
it brought my old dry skin to wow soft smooth and a lot younger looking......

avis.titre: This product might be amazing for you…
avis.texte: I have only used this product a few times over the past week, but I'm adding it to a mostly Sunday Riley routine. When I get home from work I do my night routine ASAP, because this oil needs time to absorb. Yes, it's going to make your face oily. This is not a light moisturizer to use under your makeup. I like to put this on after my other nighttime products, but before my moisturizer, and let it sit for 2 hours or so. I put my nighttime moisturizer on just before bed. I wash in the morning with a super gentle cleanser and moisturize with drunk elephant polypeptide cream. This product will give amazing results to some people, and it's probably the complete opposite of what others would want. But that's because it gives noticeable results, which is what I think most people are looking for in a product. So if you are looking for a super moisturizing oil, not a moisturizer, and you have time to let this absorb, then this is amazing product for you. It will make your skin look healthy and dewy and plush. If you're acne prone, proceed with caution. No issues here, but that's why I'm only using it 3x a week. Also, you can put this on your neck and chest for the most gorgeous glow!
Using this stuff for some contact dermatitis I have recently got, and it has been a dream! No harsh stingy feeling and it's so soothing! Highly recommend

I use several products from this line, and like them very much. This one is a turn off for me because of the nigella. It is such a strong smell, & I'm familiar with it. I added a drop of geranium oil to help with the smell. I can still smell the nigella. won't be buying this again. I use the vitamin C, lactic acid, and the tumeric on a regular basis.
Huge fan. Recommended to me when j cane in looking for argan oil.. this is really light and absorbs easily at any time of day/night. Skin is much more hydrated. Love this product!

Giving this brand a try and so glad I did. It's amazing for my skin and this oil omg it has done wonders in just 1 day using with the brand cleanser and vitamin C moisturizer. This oil is definitely a must have with the great ingredients. It eliminated a patchy problematic area between my brows which didn't seem to permanently go away with other natural oils and even pure aloe from the plant. It's a very light oil which I love. Definitely a staple for me hands down and I think my favorite!

Amazing amazing facial oil. Does wonders for your skin. I bought it for the ingredients but I ended up loving it. So very hydrating & healing. It also plumps & just gives an overall step up to your skin. I use this at night after I apply my Tret, & will never use anything else. Will continue to buy.
A beautiful oil containing rich ingredients. I love the scent of Juno oil, its density and how it makes my skin feel. Juno has numerous benefits and can be used on the hair and nails as well.

This oil is amazing, it feels good and I've seen good results. The only negative is the smell, it smells horrible. Please add something to make this smell better or I won't be able to recommend it to others. This should be a five star review but I have to take points for the smell.
This healed my eye rash, amazing organic oil. Can be used for anything.
This is my third bottle of Juno oil. Absolutely love it. Makes my skin silky smooth.

It's amazing! Nothing has made my skin as soft and glowing as Juno! Co-workers and friends have asked me what I'm doing to, or putting on my face. This stuff is magic! It makes my skin so soft. And smooth. I actually get excited to put it on my face everyday!

I'm hooked not on just on Sunday Riley as a whole, but with Juno specifically. The way my skin looks and feels… from a completely natural product made just from seed oils… is incredible. It smells earthy to me (because it's from the earth) in a good way, and calms my skin. I don't know what else to say, it's the best of the best.

I originally did the oil sample pack & found that I loved all of the oils. I love using this one when I have extra dry skin days. Some days it feels like a lot of my other skin care burns my skin. This oil is perfect for those days. It soothes my sensitive skin & helps hydrate it. I love it!

avis.titre: The best thing for your face
avis.texte: I love this product. It feels so good on my skin. My skin is softer and more radiant. I put this on each night before bed. I am sure my face is saying thank you, thank you.

Juno is a lifesaver for me and my daughter. We have extremely sensitive skin and Juno is the only skincare product that we can use daily and without irritation. I use it daily for my dry skin and it is the only thing that soothes my sensitive skin. I wish it came in a bigger bottle!

avis.titre: Wow! I love the feel and smell of Juno!
avis.texte: I use this mixed with my lip balm to help with dry chapped lips. After the first night my lips were hydrated and not chapped. First time in years. I also mixed this with my body lotion and my body feels so moisturized. Also, I like the smell. It's an earthy smell I've found in several Sunday Riley products.

I picked this up to try as my skin was so dry. I use in the am over my moisturizer and before my makeup and my skin just soaks it up. Light faint smell( I am sensitive to smells and this is totally fine). My skin was so dry that I kept developing the cystic acne and this has helped 1000%! If you have dry skin over 40 this is a must.

avis.titre: Great gave oil with one drawback
avis.texte: I purchased this oil about 4 weeks ago and have been using it daily. It is fairly thick and very hydrating. It does have a slight earthy smell but does not linger. My only issue is that the dropper does not do a good job of dispersing the oil. It appears to be too large and instead of being able to get a few drops of oil, it just comes out in a puddle.
My absolute favorite. This oil moisturizes and makes my skin glow!

I am 60 and have tried lots of skincare lines Sunday Riley has been the best noticed immediately the improvement. This product is very nice and noticed a huge improvement once I started using. I learned a little is all I need for entire face so it's not to oily. I literally use 2 small drops for my entire face. My skin is softer and pores look a lot better. I use it after the pink drink and before the vitamin c cream or at night before the vitamin A cream. It does have a vitamin E smell to it. But if you don't use to much it's not bad and goes away quickly.

Let's start off by saying this product is cruelty free. Automatic green light. The smell is natural and fresh. If you like products that add fragrance that age your skin, you're probably not used to natural smells. It smells clean, not chemically. It's earthy, and I love it. Now actually trying the product, that's on a whole new level. I bought this to wear under my makeup during the harsh, dry winter. This helps my makeup blend better, not crack, not look cakey, and gives it a more airbrushed look. I did not expect a facial oil to do that! I just wanted to add moisture, and I won the lottery with this. Now excluding use with makeup products, I wear it before bed or when I give myself a facial. I add it to my skin care routine: wash, exfoliate, serum, oil, lotion. I honestly only bought this expecting a boost in hydration. I was pleasantly surprised to notice that not only is my complexion moisturized, my wrinkles/lines/texture nourishing are blurred, my hyperpigmentation scars have lightened, my complexion has more of a glow, and my skin has a plump to it. It feel's nourishing. I've only been using this daily for 1-2 weeks. I recommend this product. I didn't have any bad reactions, but everyone's skin is different. I have oily complexion, and my skin is the opposite of sensitive. Adding the oil helps my skin not produce more oil. This oil absorbs well. I haven't had any issues with my makeup looking more oily. I still need a repowder halfway through the night. I think that's

avis.titre: Brought my facial swelling down considerably
avis.texte: Seems to be a take on the clarins plant oils which I love- nothing beats those for me. But this does have really good results especially for being plant/fruit/ veggie oil without the actives that are on trend right now. I love it and will probably repurchase.
When I use the product is causing some breakouts on my skin. I'm 40 and don't have acne, but this does cause some acne for me since it's an oil.
I have received compliments from strangers about my skin since I started using this product. We all love to hear that!! Will buy Juno over and over again :)

I have very unproblematic skin and I love facial oils so I was excited to try this one. This oil gave me the worst breakouts of my life and I was in denial for a long time I was thinking these were hormonal breakouts but when I stopped using the oil the breakouts went away. I live in a pretty dry climate with normal/dry skin

avis.titre: Great Facial Oil for Oily, Acne Prone and Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I purchased this oil from Boxycharm at a greatly reduced price and stored it in my refrigerator and It has stayed the same color and doesn't have a bad smell by the time I got to it. My skin loves this and doesn't cause breakouts. I love it!
I'm 68 years and this lady in the store could not believe it, she kept saying you look amazing

avis.titre: It is good for dry skin
avis.texte: It is little tin for my dry skin, but my face feels fresh and glowing. I love it.
Absorbs into skin well. I have oily skin and like to use this during the winter months at night.

normally I love sunday riley products their ufo oil is great, however I tried this one bc my skin was drying out a lot due to weather changes and new medication. I have pretty sensitive skin and am extremely acne prone and thus just did not do it for me. after using this, my skin looks the worst it has in about a year. i don't want to complete blame it on the product because i also started a new medication, however after stopping using it for even about a week my skin is looking a little better. i think hydration wise if does it's job but something about it did not agree with my skin.

I bought this after reading an article that had rated it as one of the five best face oils. The ingredients looked great and I wanted a face oil going into Fall/Winter. I'm very pleased with this product though I've only used it for like a week. A lot of people complained about the smell in the reviews but I like it- It smells all natural. Love the bottle as well.
We love Juno and use it every day. My skin just isn't the same without it. We use it with CEO glow serum after and pink drink beforehand.
An excellent addition to my moisturizing regimen. It works well with my other products and soaks into the skin without leaving a greasy residue.
This oil feels so good on your skin. I have also been using it on the ends of my hair.

I got this face oil as part of their mini sample kit because I couldn't decide which one I wanted to try. This was the clear winner, and I ended up purchasing the full size bottle. I actually put it on after my serum before my face cream. I swear this keeps my skin hydrated and glowing all day. I noticed an immediate difference in my skin after the first use. I absolutely love it so much so I got some as gifts for friends.
I absolutely love this. I could use it forever. The smell reminds me of vegetable oil… but it makes me so glowy. I use every day for my face, neck, hands and ends of my hair. #1 Sunday Riley product!

I have combination/oily skin and have had an on/off relationship with facial oils, with most of them not seemingly doing anything. I got this one as a sample and ended up buying the 0.5 ounce a few times now. It has an almost nutty scent at first but does not linger. It does not irritate my sensitive skin one bit and is fine to use even when I have a rosacea flare up. It does not cause any breakouts. I use 2-3 drops, warm them in my hand, and then pat it on my face after all my other skin care at night. (Or if I'm in a hurry, I will mix it with my night cream.) It soaks in over about 30 minutes and in the morning my skin is bouncy and fresh, not greasy.
It makes my skin feel so soft, and totally glowy. I use it after washing, you don't need much so it will last a long time. Totally recommend, didn't even have an adjustment period with it.

This products is literally my savior. I have sensitive skin and is prone to breakouts. I never really included an facial oil because I was scared it would cause more breakouts but with so many people telling me that this is the best of best I had to see for myself. I am so glad I did because I no longer suffer from acne and I'm confident in my skin for the first time in a long time.

Really good oil. Made my skin glow, and hydrated my dry skin very effectively. I can feel that it's improving my skin, and I love how it seals in the moisture after I apply the oil after moisturizer. Do yourself a favor and try this oil! It is the best

I love using this antioxidant packed oil! It makes my face feel so nice and also helps with my gua sha massage. It just feels like it's good for you and absorbs really well! My skin loves it - I use good genes after !

This is the first Sunday Riley product I've tried because they are pretty pricey, but now I see why. They actually work!! I've been using this product for about a month now and my skin looks amazing!! My redness is evening out and my face is so incredibly smooth and glowing. I love it! There are a couple things I don't care for very much...the smell (it is very strong) and how oily it is. I know it's an oil so it's supposed to be oily, but this just seems a little extra and it takes a long time to sink into the skin. I thought maybe I was using too much so I cut back, but it's still super oily. I use this in my night time routine so I have to sleep with a towel on my pillow in order to not ruin my pillowcases. Regardless, I will definitely be repurchading this product!!!
Still giving it a try. It has an odor that I find unpleasant, but it does moisturize nicely.

I've used Sunday Riley products (daily) for over a year & I love them all, JUNO is my new favorite! It's moisturizing, on face, cuticles, even elbows. I've added it to my morning and evening routine. Yes, I highly recommend!

I bought the smaller bottle while on vacation. Me and my daughter fell in love with this product. Use it on face nails and on my scalp occasionally (Chemo hair loss.). I went back and bought ordered the larger bottle next. The smell reminds me sort of being out in the "trees", can't really describe it. It's a pleasant smell. I don't like perfumery so this fit my bill. Leaves my skin soft and not greasy. Will keep buying as long as I keep loving it!
My skin is sensitive/acne prone. Juno does a superb job of reducing the redness on my face and still giving me a dewy glow. I haven't had any issues with breakouts.
Not pleased with the smell, just started using the other night. I will say that its more of a daytime use. It's far to oily for night use.
A good moisture oil. Doesn't sting my eyes. Will carry travel size in my bag!

Love it. Really good for my dry /dehydrated skin. Rich, luxurios, but not greasy. Its a real treat to use this morning and evening. I use it over Luna Sleeping Night Oil in the evenings for added benefit.

I have been using daily for two weeks now. I use about 5 drops for my face & neck. I have noticed that it softens the appearance, & texture of my skin. My skin breaks out less & people tell me my skin glows.

avis.titre: Do your skin a favor and buy this!
avis.texte: For someone who had once suffered from oily skin using a face oil seemed completely insane. I happened to have gotten a full size bottle of a similar oil in a Singles Swag Box. I thought that was liquid gold until I tried this brand (which was less expensive btw) And it actually smells better, is more light weight and gives me GLOWING, healthy and all around amazing skin. I use this at night before my face cream and wake up feeling fresh, never greasy. I absolutely love this product.

Ugh… I love JUNO… and it might be up there in my holyiest of grails. Juno was one of the very last SR products I tried because honestly, I didn't know what to do with it or where to put it in my routine. I have sensitive, acne prone, rosacea skin and in the northeast winter my face is disgustingly dry. I now use Juno over moisturizer morning and night and I can't even properly described what it's done for my skin. More even skin tone, less texture, less redness and even less acne (which is insane because it DOES sit on top of my skin). Give JUNO a try… you won't be disappointed!
Instantly my skin appeared healthier and hydrated I love this product.
Amazing product. Does not hurt my skin. My skin absorbs it and LOVES it.

avis.titre: I wanted to love it… made my face dry
avis.texte: I love Sunday Riley, let's make that clear ! But… I wanted to love this oil but I returned it. This made my face so dry ! At first it's a oil so it's moisturizing but by morning I would have flakes of dry skin all over my cheeks. I also don't have dry skin. I kept trying it over a few times just to make sure and it for sure is the product. Hopefully this doesn't happen to others. Moving on to a different oil.

This is an amazing oil. So many uses. I've used it on a burn to help it heal faster (with minimal scaring), I use it in my cuticles (better than any cuticle oil out there) and of course I use it on my face. Wonderful as a wind protection in the cold blustery winter days.
An overall terrific face oil that I use on cuticles, elbows and other dry areas. An excellent healer.
I received Juno in my Ipsy bag. When your husband of over 21 years tells you your skin looks good....you keep using the product. I just love the way my skin looks and feels great!
Day or night use. Product truly nourishes skin! Especially after environmental and physiological stresses.

This is the one and only beauty product I use. I am a fair complected red head with the world's MOST sensitive skin, a fragrance allergy and rosacea. This oil is super hydrating, lifts, firms, and most importantly calms my skin and controls my rosacea. No irritation at all. There is an earthy smell that does not seem to irritate my skin and goes away after application. Very thick. A little goes a long way. I have received complements on my bare skin with no makeup while using this which has NEVER happened before. I use it on my cuticles and to calm my hair frizz as well. Do not EVER stop making this!

This is my go to product! My skin glows, and as someone who doesn't wear makeup, it's a need. I constantly get compliments on my skin, I'm 47 and thankfully, always get mistaken for being in my early 30's! Some of it is good genes (thanks, Mom!) but I honestly think a lot of it is due to this product. I love the feel of it, not too oily and absorbs beautifully. It also tackles any dark spots before they get comfortable.

I love it. I have psoriasis on my palms. My hands are so dry, most oils and emollients don't actually penetrate and moisturize the skin. This oil keeps my hands from feeling itchy and dry for HOURS. The oil also doesn't transfer too much once applied to the skin. Most of these products are very expensive for continued use. However, since the pandemic, I've had problems getting to the dermatologist. This oil has been beyond helpful for the times I don't have a prescription.
I just started the product about a week now, so far my skin looks more hydrated not as dry. However I would apply it at night because I noticed some irritation if I do it morning and night.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this again!
avis.texte: I'm always on the search fir something hydrating that makes my skin feel good. This is it! My skin drinks it in and leaves it velvety soft and glowing. I won't be without it again.

I'm so obsessed with this oil, it hydrates well and has really improved my skin texture and tone. Really soothing for my sensitive skin as well! I bought the small one and I've already rushed through half of it, definitely upgrading to the big one!
Winter dries out my skin so much. This oil hydrated without being greasy. It absorbs like a dream. My husband loves it too!
I never thought I would use a face oil, but this one is not greasy at all!! I actually use it in the morning and at night.
I like this product more for my nails, cuticles and neck more than my face actually. Very hydrating and has an oily look to it.
Absolutely love this oil...makes my skin glow...use in morning...after shower..

I've used this for years and it's consistently helpful with my extremely dry and sensitive (doctor diagnosed) rosacea. I rub 4 drops between my hands and softly pat onto my dry or sightly damp face. My rosacea is truly horrendous so I do use other moisturizers (ice and a calming one from another brand) and I also moisturize frequently throughout the day. But even so, juno helps, doesn't exacerbate anything, and is pretty moderately priced considering how long it lasts me. I often get the smaller size bc I've found sometimes Sunday Riley products oxidize faster than I would expect.
I love Juno so far! I use this during the day and Luna at night! Definitely great!

I'm actually kind of annoyed at how amazing this product is because it means you guys are going to be taking even more of my money lol. I have incredibly sensitive, dry skin and it immediately eased and healed my poor chapped skin.
Nice smell and feels nice on my skin. A little goes a long way. I had an initial breakout bc I am so sensitive to new products, but my skin looks nice now.
It really helps to keep my skin hydrated... it doesn't break me out... love it

I've only been using this for about 4 days but so far so good. I put it on at night after washing and then a little bit in the morning along with my Sunday Riley CEO glow vitamin C. I agree that it smells earthy but it's not a bad smell! A little goes a veryy long way- if you apply too much it can make your face very greasy, so be conservative when applying. Very hydrating and I think it's already helped brighten up my skin tone. I also put a little on my neck and hands because why not!
I use this on days "I go light". I use it alone with auto correct and lip balm!

this is my baby. my love lol. my face looks amazing and less acne . I use it todo exercises and omg it just go tomy skin and took out my black points. the package is great, but by mistake i let it open and the half of my bottle spread out :(

I've been using this product nightly for almost a month. Was super nervous it would break me out because it goes on very oily. However, when I wake up in the morning, my skin feels amazing. No extra oiliness, just smooth, moisturized skin! I bought the smaller bottle and it was bigger than I thought it would be. I would def buy it again!
Use each morning & evening. Mix a drop or two with tint. Noticed more supple skin, smoother & healthier all around. My neck looks so much smoother too!

I have dry/normal with hormonal acne, especially very dry in the winter. I never had cystic acne, but a pimple or 2 sure and it always levels a mark after it flattens out. I am very careful with making sure all the products I use are non-comedogenic and overall decent ingredients. I had a small pimple on my chin the night I started this oil. I washed and toned with my usual products and put about 6 drops and rubbed on my face and added 3 my drops for my neck. It felt nice and soothing to my dry skin and absorbed in my skin within 10 minutes and I woke up with the zit totally flattened out! And since I've been using the oil nightly my skin has been moisturized and clear! Worth the $$
This product is a must have! The hydration my face gets is amazing.

I use this product after washing my face with Cerave facial cleanser for oily skin which can be quite drying. and then i lather my face up on days i don't wear makeup / at night after i take my makeup off. this oil is very thick, and i find it does take most of the day for it to settle in, so your face is oily pretty much all day --- which is fine for me if im not planning on leaving the house. its a good facial oil and i wake up with soft feeling skin in the AM. its made with all seed oils, no bad chemicals which i love. smells like broccoli which is fine with me if its coming from all natural ingredients!

For the last few months, I've been dealing with patchy red flaky areas, peeling skin, crepey skin, dull skin. You name it. I've bought moisturizer after moisturizer. Used masks. Exfoliated. Not exfoliated. Stayed away from makeup or piled it on. I was at my wit's end. I'm on day 3 with this product. Morning and evening, immediately after washing and using Micellar water. I already see my skin glowing. More even tone and texture. Generally just not looking like someone drained the life out of my face. Will purchase again.

I have a few of the Sunday Riley facial oils. I wanted to try this one. So far I'm really enjoying it because this well in my opinion is a little thicker than the other oils that Sunday Riley makes and in the north east winter I find I need a little bit more moisturization. The thing I like about Sunday Riley oils is that there is not a lot of filler chemicals and the ingredient deck is good. I would definitely get this again
A bit heavy for daytime use for me, but I still will use it once or twice a week. Definitely plumps, hydrates, and makes skin SHINE!
Juno is the first oil I've used. I love that it's a general facial oil. I also use it on hands and cuticles as well as the ends of my hair! Smell isn't great, but I don't mind it either.

Obsessed. Literally the only thing that can get rid of my dry skin here in the Nevada desert in winter! Very soothing and smells good too. Packaging was premium so this is a great gift item. A little goes a long way.

This oil is great for my super dry spots! It stays on, hydrates, and doesnt wipe off that easily. If you have greasy skin, this may not be the best as it does maintain an oily residue (but smells so nice). Recommended for dry skin and people who really need that protective layer to hydrate your skin.

Huge fan! I live in Wisconsin where it's quite cold during the winter. I've added this to my daily routine to seal in the moisture, especially when I'm going outside for a walk. It makes my face glow!
Love the smell and color of this product! Skin feeling silky smooth after two weeks of using it.
This is my all-time favorite. It really works to smooth my skin, even it's tone, and erase fine lines. To think that an oil could make my face look so smooth and feel so velvety!

I bought this specifically for the combination of oils after extensive research, and I'm really loving it. A little goes a LONG way, even on my super dry areas, because it is a thicker texture and very rich. The smell is kind of fruity with a little earthiness from the carrot seed, not a strong smell, bit I know some people have complained--that's the natural smells of these oils.

So here's the deal: Juno is a staple for all skin related woes. I layer it atop a moisturizer to lock in hydration, I rub it into my cuticles for healthy nails, I add a little to my hairline to keep flyaway hairs at bay. And keep in mind that a little goes a long ways so you only need a couple of very small droplets with each usage.

This has done wonders to my face. My skin is very sensitive, I often break out in hives from trying different products that may contain fragrance.... BUT this Juno oil just leaves my face with an even glow. I only use it at night!

I tried the smaller bottle first and fell in love with it instantly! My skin was dry after giving birth and breast feeding and this magical oil brought it back to life. I was shocked at how fast I noticed the difference. Now I always make sure I am never out of this product. I don't use it everyday, but as soon as I see my skin "acting up" this oil is my fast and most effective solution

avis.titre: Best Antioxidant Face Oil you can buy!
avis.texte: I use this product at night on top of my moisterizer. I have very dry and aging skin, so this product is the best one I've ever used, and believe me I've used a lot of different high end kinds of face oils.
The is a must-have in my skin routine. Reliefs a multitude of dryness problems
This oil is such an great product. Glad I'm able to add this to my skincare routine.
